strings.原型：1942 年，英国商船“贝洛蒙”号在大西洋被鱼雷击沉，中国海员潘濂独自在一: Based on: in 1942 the British merchant ship Ben Lomond was torpedoed in the Atlantic, and the Chinese seaman Poon Lim drifted alone on a raft for 133 days — he bent a spring from a flashlight into a fish hook, caught rain in the canvas cover of a life jacket, ate fish and seabirds raw, and was finally picked up by Brazilian fishermen. strings.后半夜，守夜的人把所有人推醒：海平线上有灯光——两盏白色的桅灯一高一低，下面一盏: In the small hours the watch shakes everyone awake: lights on the horizon — two white masthead lights, one high and one low, a green sidelight beneath them. A big ship, crossing a few nautical miles north of the raft.
strings.后半夜，瘪透了的筏子被一个浪压进了水里。所有人在黑暗里抓着扶手绳、抓着彼此，拼命: In the small hours a wave drives the spent raft under. In the dark everyone grabs the lifeline, grabs each other, bailing and blowing into the buoyancy tubes for all they are worth…
strings.后半夜，西南边的海平线上亮起一大片雪白的光，亮得像一座小城——是灯光渔船在围鱿鱼: In the small hours a broad sheet of white light comes up on the southwestern horizon, bright as a small city — squid boats fishing under their lamps. They may be seven or eight nautical miles off; they will barely move all night.
strings.后半夜，风暴果然来了。筏子被浪打得东倒西歪，可因为提前拴牢了，什么也没丢。: In the small hours the storm does come. The raft is knocked every which way, but everything was lashed down beforehand, and nothing is lost.
strings.后半夜，鲨鱼又撞了一下筏底。旺财吓得蹦了起来，冲着水面狂吠，四只爪子在下层浮胎上: In the small hours a shark hits the underside again. Lucky bolts up in terror, barking at the water, all four paws scrabbling at the lower buoyancy tube — and by the time he is pinned down, the tube has a string of pinholes bubbling along it. An inflatable raft and dog claws were never meant to share a space.
strings.后来阿杰考了正规的水手证，第一次领工资，给师傅买了一根不锈钢拐杖。老潘嫌它太亮，: Later Jake sat the exam for a proper seaman's certificate, and with his first pay he bought his old master a stainless-steel cane. Old Pan thought it too shiny; he never leaned on it once. It hung on a nail by the door of his house.
strings.听证会开了三天。郑国栋没请律师，问什么答什么，最后在笔录上按了手印。船长适任证书: The inquiry ran three days. Gordon Zheng hired no lawyer, answered whatever he was asked, and in the end pressed his thumbprint to the deposition. His master's certificate was revoked, and the company billed him line by line for the demurrage and the death benefits. Someone saw him afterwards at Yantai, casting off lines for a tour boat at the pier.
strings.咬牙把手上的活干完: Grit your teeth and finish the job
strings.啪的一声，线断了。鲯鳅带着鱼钩消失在深水里。: The line parts with a snap. The mahi-mahi takes the hook down into deep water.
strings.喝几口海水: Drink a few mouthfuls of seawater
strings.喝海水会让人更渴：海水含盐约 3.5%，比肾脏能排出的最浓的尿还咸，喝下去的盐要: Seawater only makes you thirstier: it is about 3.5% salt, saltier than the most concentrated urine the kidneys can produce, and every bit of that salt has to be flushed out with more water from the body. It eases the thirst for the first few hours, then deepens the dehydration and brings on hypernatremia — headache, delirium, hallucinations, and at the far end convulsions and death.
strings.嗓子像塞了一把沙子。海水就在手边，又清又凉。有人小声说，老辈人讲过：少喝几口海水: Your throat feels packed with sand. The sea is right there at your hand, clear and cool. Someone says, quietly, that the old people had a saying: a few mouthfuls of seawater will not kill you.
strings.四天的电要用在刀刃上；可船来的时候未必有人醒着: Four days of battery, and every minute of it counts — but a ship may pass when no one is awake to see it
strings.在机舱里干了二十多年，一双手什么都能修。上了筏子，他第一个拆开了那台摔裂的手摇淡: Twenty-odd years in engine rooms left him with hands that could fix anything. On the raft he was the first to take the cracked hand-pump desalinator apart. "It can be fixed," he said. "It takes time." Five years alongside the captain, and neither man had any use for the other.
strings.在海面上冒三分钟橙色浓烟，白天最醒目；风大时烟会被压在浪头上。: Three minutes of thick orange smoke on the water, brightest by day; in a heavy wind the smoke gets flattened down onto the wave tops.
strings.坐在篷布底下，一下一下地压淡化器的手柄，每分钟三十下，一摇就是五个小时。胳膊会累: Sitting under the canopy, working the desalinator handle stroke after stroke, thirty a minute for five hours at a stretch. Your arms will about drop off and you will sweat plenty, but one man can pump out around 2 L of fresh water. The longer you pump, the dirtier the membrane, and the less comes through.
strings.堵漏夹只拧上了一半，口子还在冒小泡。: The clamp is only half tightened; the tear is still bubbling.
strings.堵漏夹拧上了。{actor} 被拽回筏子的时候，嘴唇都泡白了。: The clamp is on. By the time they haul {actor} back into the raft, {actor.his} lips are white and sodden.
strings.堵漏锥、堵漏夹和自粘修补片。修淡化器也要用到。: Plug, clamp and self-adhesive patch. You will need them to repair the desalinator, too.
strings.多一张嘴，多一份水，筏子会挤到满员；他看起来是个老渔民: One more mouth, one more share of water, and the raft is full to capacity; he looks like an old fisherman
strings.夜里偷偷塞给阿杰: Sneak it to Jake in the night
strings.夜里旺财在浮胎上刨了几下想找个凉快地方，天亮时，下层浮胎上多了几个冒细泡的小孔。: In the night Lucky scratches at the tube looking for a cooler spot; by morning the lower buoyancy tube has a few new pinholes bubbling.
strings.夜里最醒目，二三十海里外都看得见；信号弹只剩 {res.flares}: Most visible at night, seen from twenty or thirty nautical miles; only {res.flares} flares left
strings.夜里，一艘路过的货轮突然减速、转向——SART 的应答信号在它的雷达屏上排成了一: In the night a passing freighter suddenly slows and comes about — the SART's reply stacks up into a string of bright dots on its radar.
strings.夜里，小满挪到钱卫东旁边，小声问：“钱伯，那天晚上我叔下机舱之前骂了一句，说老轨: In the night Danny edges over to Victor Qian and asks, low: "Uncle Qian, the night my uncle went down to the engine room he swore about something — said the chief was drunk again, that he rang three times and could not wake him… was he talking about you?" The multi-tool stops in Victor Qian's hand.
strings.夜里，筏底被什么东西重重撞了一下，整个筏子都弹了起来。接着又是一下。手电照下去，: In the night something strikes the underside hard and the whole raft jumps. Then it strikes again. In the flashlight beam a whitetip shark, more than 2 m long, rolls its pale belly up and slides slowly beneath the raft.
strings.够所有人吃好几天，血也能喝；那个孩子会恨你们一辈子: Meat enough for everyone for days, and blood to drink; the boy will hate you all for the rest of his life
strings.大人们挡在小满前面，用桨把那件橘红色的救生衣推远了。小满没有哭。那天一整天，他一: The adults stand in front of Danny and push the orange life jacket away with an oar. Danny does not cry. He says nothing all that day.
strings.大家商量了半天，最后决定让最懂海图的人走。: They argue it back and forth for a long time, and in the end send the one who knows the charts best.
strings.大家把最撑不住的人一个一个扶上了邦卡船。: One by one they help the ones who cannot hold on any longer onto the bangka.
strings.大家把衣服摊在篷顶上晒干，宁可热着。: They spread their clothes on top of the canopy to dry, and put up with the heat.
strings.大家照着他的比划，把水袋、干粮、信号弹一样一样拴在扶手绳上，又把海锚绳放到最长。: Following his gestures, they lashed the water bags, the dry rations and the flares to the lifeline one by one, and paid the sea-anchor line out as far as it would go. Nguyen Van Hung checked every knot, then nodded at them.
strings.大家眼巴巴地看着头几捧水从槽口淌进海里，直到舔一口不再发咸。: They watch the first handfuls of water run off the gutter into the sea, until a lick of it stops tasting of salt.
strings.大家约好：太阳到头顶的时候，再把衣服泡湿。: They agree: when the sun is overhead, then the clothes get soaked.
strings.大家都不说话了。小满一夜没合眼，一直搂着狗脖子。: Nobody speaks. Danny stays awake all night with his arms round the dog's neck.
strings.大家都指望着这点活: Everyone is counting on this work getting done
strings.大家都没力气了，顾不上: No one has the strength left to care
strings.天亮了。罗德尔看了看天，说他得走了——油只够回马辛洛克，再晚就要撞上下一场风。他: Daylight. Rodel looks at the sky and says he has to go — he has fuel enough to reach Masinloc and no more, and any later and the next blow will catch him. His bangka is narrow as a length of timber: apart from him and his son-in-law it can take two more at the most, and three would turn it over. He asks: who is coming with me?
strings.天亮后才发现，下层浮胎上多了几道擦痕，正在一串一串地冒小泡。: Only at daybreak do they find the new scrapes on the lower buoyancy tube, bubbling in strings.
strings.天亮的时候，{protagonist} 蜷在筏子的角落里，安静了下来。: By the time it is light, {protagonist} lies curled in the corner of the raft and is quiet.
strings.天亮的时候，阮文雄不见了。筏尾的拖环上只剩下半截割断的绳头，他带来的那只塑料油壶: By the time it is light, Nguyen Van Hung is gone. Only a cut length of rope is left on the tow ring at the stern, and the plastic fuel can he brought is gone with him. Someone remembers hearing water in the night and taking it for a fish.
strings.天亮的时候，风浪小了。四周只有灰绿色的涌浪，看不见残骸，也看不见别的筏子。船上的: When it grew light the sea had eased. There was nothing but grey-green swell all round: no wreckage, no other raft. The emergency position-indicating radio beacon (EPIRB) should have floated free when the ship went down and sent its distress call up to the satellites — but no one had seen it come up. Out in the world they knew only that the Haichuan 9 was missing; they did not know where she lay.
strings.天刚亮，阮文雄突然站了起来，差点把筏子弄翻。他指着西南边海平线上的一个小黑点，嗓: At first light Nguyen Van Hung stands up so suddenly he nearly capsizes them. He points at a black speck on the southwestern horizon, his voice cracking: "Tàu cá! Tàu cá Việt Nam!" A wooden-hulled fishing boat with two big blue eyes painted on its bow, working slowly west, three or four nautical miles off at the least.
strings.天快亮时，一条收网的渔船发现了这只朝它们慢慢划来的筏子。: Just before dawn a fishing boat hauling in its nets finds the raft creeping toward it.
strings.天快黑时，鲣鸟拍拍翅膀飞走了。: As the light goes, the booby beats its wings and is gone.
strings.太阳像钉子一样钉在头顶。篷布外的海面白得晃眼，连浮胎都烫手。每个人的脸、手背和小: The sun is nailed overhead. Beyond the canopy the sea is a blinding white; even the buoyancy tubes are too hot to touch. Every face, every hand, every calf is blistered red.
strings.她一字一句地复述了那通电话。船长没有反驳，只是把脸转向了海面。: She repeats the phone call word for word. The captain does not argue; he only turns his face to the sea.
strings.她的秘密会被揭开——而她也知道你的秘密: Her secret will come out — and she knows yours
strings.威严、沉稳，习惯发号施令；把船员的命看得很重，更看重“船长”这两个字。心里压着天: Commanding, steady, used to being obeyed; he sets great store by his crew's lives, and more by the word "captain." An enormous guilt sits on him and he will never admit a fault out loud; challenge his authority and he turns cold and hard.
strings.存不了多少，但现在就能解渴: You cannot store much, but the thirst goes now
strings.孩子会信你；哪天真相出来，他会恨你: The boy will believe you; when the truth comes out, he will hate you
strings.孩子会闭嘴，也会怕你；别人未必没听见: The boy will shut up, and he will be afraid of you; the others may well have heard
strings.孩子，别老盯着水底下。看天。: Boy. Stop staring down into the water. Watch the sky.
strings.宁波口音，爱冷笑，口头禅是“我早讲过的”“侬懂啥”。: A Ningbo accent, a taste for the cold laugh; his stock lines are "I told you so" and "What would you know."
strings.它太远了，几乎不可能看见: It is too far off; there is almost no chance they will see us
strings.它还要分你们的水和吃的: It eats your food and drinks your water too
strings.实话实说：检查表上签字的是苏晓雯: Tell the truth: the signature on the inspection sheet is Wendy Su's
strings.小满一下子不吭声了，缩到了篷布最里面。那天夜里，他是抱着膝盖坐着睡的。: Danny goes quiet at once and shrinks to the very back of the canopy. That night he sleeps sitting up, arms round his knees.
strings.小满上船之前，搂着旺财的脖子搂了很久，最后把它推回了筏子里。: Before Danny gets on the boat he holds Lucky round the neck for a long time, then pushes him back into the raft.
strings.小满捧着罐头盖喝得很急，喝完舔了舔嘴，再也没提这件事。: Danny drinks fast from the can lid, licks his lips when he is done, and never mentions it again.
strings.小满是坐着菲律宾渔船回来的。在马辛洛克的海岸警卫队办公室里，他借了一部手机给妈妈: Danny came back on a Philippine fishing boat. In the Coast Guard office at Masinloc he borrowed a phone and called his mother, and the first thing he said was, "Ma. Uncle's gone." When school started again he wrote a composition called "Grandpa Rodel."
strings.少受罪，但今天什么也别想干: Less suffering — but nothing gets done today
strings.少接一点，但接到的都是能喝的淡水: You catch less, but all of it is drinkable
strings.尽量让身上保持干燥: Keep as dry as you can
strings.干了一辈子的水手长，阿杰的师傅，大家都叫他老潘。弃船时他泡在水里，把别人一个个推: A boatswain all his working life, and Jake's master; everyone called him Old Pan. When they abandoned ship he was in the water, pushing the others up onto the raft one by one, and he was the last man hauled aboard. A torn hull plate had opened a deep gash in his right thigh, and the blood would not stop.
strings.干粮早就吃完了，这几天一条鱼也没钓上来。旺财瘦得肋骨一根一根地凸出来，还是每天趴: The dry rations are long gone, and no fish has come aboard for days. Lucky is so thin that every rib stands out, and still he lies at the entrance every day, whining at the shadows of fish in the water. Someone watches him for a long time and says, voice hoarse: "There is a good fifteen pounds of meat on him." Danny throws his arms round the dog's neck.
strings.弃船前你冲回厨房，抓了两瓶五百五十毫升的矿泉水，塞在救生衣底下带上了筏。你谁也没: Before you abandoned ship you ran back to the galley, grabbed two 550 mL bottles of mineral water and carried them onto the raft under your life jacket. You told no one — they were for Jake.
strings.当场掀开他的救生衣: Open his life jacket right there
strings.当着所有人的面追问：到底怎么回事: Ask him in front of everyone: what really happened
strings.悄悄凑过去：分我一口，我就当没看见: Sidle over: slip me a bite and I saw nothing
strings.憨、贪吃、胆子大，见了鲨鱼的背鳍就冲着海面狂吠。认人：谁给过它一口吃的，它就一直: Dumb, greedy and bold. The moment he sees a shark fin he barks his head off at the water. He knows people: whoever has fed him once, he plants himself at that person's feet. When the heat comes on he just sits there with his mouth open, panting.
strings.成了就是好几天的口粮；可它在筏子里乱撞，鱼钩可能扎破浮胎: Land it and it's days of rations; but thrash it about in the raft and the hook could puncture a buoyancy tube
strings.我下去泡两个钟头: I'll go in and soak for two hours
strings.我不渴。真的，你们先喝。: I'm not thirsty. Really. You drink first.
strings.我十六岁上船，翻过两回，这是第三回。阎王爷嫌我骨头硬，不收。: I shipped out at sixteen. I've been through two sinkings. This is the third. The King of Hell says my bones are too tough. He won't have me.
strings.我叔水性好得很，他肯定在别的筏子上。是吧？是吧？: My uncle swims like a fish. He must be on another raft. Right? Right?
strings.我叔要是知道我哭了，肯定笑我。: If my uncle knew I cried, he'd laugh at me.
strings.我想吃我妈做的白切鸡，蘸沙姜的那种。: I want my mum's poached chicken, the kind with the sand-ginger dip.
strings.所有人一起挥衣服，让他用越南话喊: Everyone wave clothes together; let him shout in Vietnamese
strings.所有人仰着头，张着嘴，雨水灌进鼻子里也不管。: Everyone tipped their heads back with their mouths open, letting the rain run into their noses.
strings.所有人别动、别出声，等它自己走: Everyone stay still, stay quiet, wait for it to move on
strings.所有人抱着膝盖，屏住呼吸，听着筏底一下一下地被撞。: Everyone hugged their knees and held their breath, listening as something knocked against the underside of the raft, blow after blow.
strings.所有人看着那串灯光慢慢移过海平线，谁也没有说话。: Everyone watched the string of lights slide slowly across the horizon. Nobody said a word.
strings.所有人看着那片灯光，一直看到天亮。: Everyone watched the lights, and kept watching until dawn.
strings.所有人站在摇晃的筏子上，挥着衣服，嗓子喊哑了。: Everyone stood on the rocking raft waving clothes until their voices went.
strings.所有人站起来挥衣服、大喊: Everyone stand up, wave clothes, shout
strings.所有人轮流划桨，朝灯光划过去: Everyone takes turns at the oars, rowing for the lights
strings.所有人轮流打气、往外舀水，干一整夜: Everyone takes turns pumping and bailing, all night long
strings.所有人都要折腾一晚上；要是他看错了，就是白忙: It costs everyone a night's sleep; if he's wrong, it was all for nothing
strings.所有的容器都伸到了槽口下面，一滴也没放过。: Every container we had went under the spout. Not a drop was let go.
strings.手摇淡化器的状态。0 表示还不能用；滤膜越脏，出水越少。: State of the hand-pump desalinator. 0 means it can't be used yet; the dirtier the membrane, the less water it makes.
strings.手缩回来。鲨鱼不挑食。: Pull your hand back. Sharks aren't picky.
strings.打开 SART，赌它的雷达: Switch on the SART and gamble on their radar
strings.打气筒吱嘎吱嘎地响了一整夜，换人不换筒。天亮时，浮胎又硬了起来。: The pump creaked all night; the hands changed, the pump never did. By dawn the buoyancy tube was hard again.
strings.扔下海——筏子比狗要紧: Throw him overboard — the raft matters more than the dog
strings.扶着桨当舵，盯着太阳和风向，让小帆一直吃着风，把筏子往航道的方向推。没风的时候白: Hold an oar as a rudder, watch the sun and the wind, keep the small sail drawing, and push the raft toward the shipping lane. No wind, no use; and you spend the whole morning in the sun outside the canopy.
strings.把他推下去——本来就不该让他上来: Push him off — he never should have been let aboard
strings.把刀绑在桨上，等它再来就捅: Lash the knife to an oar and stab it when it comes back
strings.把剩下的补漏工具全用上，先堵最大的那几个口子: Use up the rest of the patch kit; plug the biggest holes first
strings.把多用刀绑在桨上，趴在筏边叉筏底下游来游去的鲯鳅和炮弹鱼。收获比钓鱼大得多，可一: Lash the multi-tool to an oar and lie at the edge of the raft, spearing the mahi-mahi and triggerfish that swim underneath. The catch is far bigger than line fishing, but one slip and the blade goes into your own buoyancy tube; fish blood brings sharks too.
strings.把它的四只爪子用布条缠起来: Wrap all four of its paws in strips of cloth
strings.把最后几页念给所有人听: Read the last pages aloud to everyone
strings.把淡化器拆开，冲洗预过滤网，重新压紧密封圈，装好后试压一遍。滤膜越脏出水越少，隔: Take the desalinator apart, rinse the pre-filter, reseat the seals, put it back together and test the pressure. The dirtier the membrane, the less water it makes; it needs doing every few days.
strings.把用不上的东西全扔下去，让筏子浮高一点: Throw everything we don't need overboard to float the raft higher
strings.把自己那盖水推给他：“小孩子别乱讲，喝吧。”: Push his own capful of water at him: "Don't talk nonsense, kid. Drink."
strings.把鱼肉拧出汁来喝，再嚼鱼眼睛: Wring the juice out of the fish flesh and drink it, then chew the eyes
strings.抽出来，偷偷看看最后几页: Pull it out and steal a look at the last pages
strings.拆下一半篷布，绑在两支桨上，做一面能吃风的小帆。: Cut half the canopy loose and lash it to two oars to make a small sail that will catch the wind.
strings.拆下一半篷布，绑在桨上做一面小帆。有了帆，顺风时筏子就能被“驶”向航道；代价是篷: Cut half the canopy loose and lash it to an oar for a small sail. With a sail the raft can be "sailed" toward the shipping lane when the wind is fair; the price is half the shade, so everyone burns worse and thirsts faster.
strings.拆了手电筒，把弹簧掰成鱼钩: Strip the flashlight and bend the spring into a fishhook
strings.拆开摔裂的手摇反渗透淡化器，用修补片剪一个密封圈，粘好膜壳上的裂缝。越修到后面，: Take apart the cracked hand-pump reverse-osmosis desalinator, cut a seal from a patch and glue the crack in the membrane housing. The further the repair goes, the more fresh water each pressure test gives; once it is fixed, one person pumping all morning gets about two litres. It takes real skill, and only two can work at it inside the raft; you need at least 1 patch kit on hand (used up when the job is done).
strings.拉过来，取下他口袋里的东西，再让他走: Pull him over, take what's in his pockets, then let him go
strings.拖一天，是给它一天，也是给自己一天: Put it off a day and it's a day for him, and a day for you
strings.拖上浮胎，好好送他一程: Haul him onto the buoyancy tube and give him a proper send-off
strings.拖它上筏的时候，海龟的前爪在浮胎上划开了一道口子。: Hauling it aboard, the turtle's front flipper opened a gash in the buoyancy tube.
strings.拿出来分给大家: Bring it out and share it round

A SART lets a passing ship's radar find you, but the battery lasts only four days.
strings.救生筏标配的压缩干粮，低蛋白，专为缺水时吃而配方；以后钓到的鱼、抓到的海鸟和海龟: The compressed ration that comes standard in a liferaft: low in protein, formulated to be eaten when water is short; fish caught and seabirds and turtles taken later are counted here too, by calories.

After Danny left for school in Dalian, he squatted at the gate of the compound every evening, waiting for the bus.

strings.水深三四千米的开阔海面，最近的陆地在两百海里外。西边一百多海里是新加坡至香港的主: Open sea, three or four thousand meters deep, with the nearest land two hundred nautical miles away. A hundred-odd nautical miles to the west lies the Singapore–Hong Kong shipping lane; but the August southwest monsoon and the currents are pushing the raft, little by little, northeast.
strings.水省着喝。舌头底下压一颗扣子，嘴里就没那么干。: Ration the water. Keep a button under your tongue and your mouth won't feel so dry.
strings.水袋被锁进了属具包。老潘喝了一小口，小满也分到一小口，其他人舔着干裂的嘴唇，看着: The water bag was locked in the equipment pack. Old Pan took a sip, Danny got one too, and the rest watched them drink, licking their cracked lips.
strings.水袋里只剩下最后 {res.water}。有人说，老潘失了那么多血，最需要水；也: Only the last {res.water} was left in the bag. Some said Old Pan had lost so much blood, he needed the water most. Others said, coldly, "He's the one least likely to live. The water should go to the men who can still work."

strings.汪！汪汪！（一片背鳍从筏边划过，它冲着水面狂吠，被人一把捏住了嘴。）: Woof! Woof woof! (A dorsal fin cut past the edge of the raft. He barked wildly at the water until someone clamped his muzzle shut.)
strings.沉默、能吃苦、极有分寸：给什么吃什么，从不伸手要。看天、看浪、看鱼的本事，比筏子: Quiet, tough, and unfailingly measured: he eats whatever he is given and never puts out a hand for more. strings.沉默了很久，说：“是我。”: He was quiet for a long time. Then he said, "It was me."

Every typhoon season he sits by the television watching the storm tracks, and watches all night.
strings.海水能冲掉脏东西，可伤口泡在盐水里会烂: Seawater washes the dirt out, but a wound left soaking in salt water rots

strings.淡水是第一条生死线：在 30℃ 的筏子里一动不动，人每天仍会失去 2–3 升水；: Fresh water is the first line between life and death: lying still inside a 30°C raft, a person still loses 2–3 L a day; work outside the canopy and add another liter or two of sweat. Short of water, the kidneys squeeze urine output down to nothing, and soaking your clothes in the day cuts the sweat too — but all of it only slows dehydration. Past 6% of body weight lost, the damage starts; past 15%, you die. A child and a dog are small; the same loss of water puts them far closer to that line.
strings.淡水能把盐冲出去；别人就要少喝了: Fresh water flushes the salt out; but someone else drinks less

strings.混乱中，水下有什么东西猛地撞了过来。等筏子翻正、所有人爬回去，才发现少了一个人。: In the confusion something under the water slammed into them. When the raft was righted and everyone had climbed back in, they found they were one short.

strings.漂流的第三十一天清晨，一艘从三亚出海的渔船发现了这只瘪了一半的救生筏。渔民们后来: On the morning of the thirty-first day adrift, a fishing boat out of Sanya found the liferaft, half deflated. strings.漂流的筏子像一块浮礁，小鱼在它的阴影下聚集，大鱼跟着小鱼来。漂得越久，鱼越多；夜: A drifting raft is a floating reef: small fish gather in its shadow, and the big fish follow the small ones. The longer it drifts, the more fish there are; flying fish that hit the raft at night, barnacles growing on its underside — all of it means a few more mouthfuls.
strings.漏点用修补片糊上了。从那天起，夜里总有一个人搂着旺财睡——它一哆嗦，那人就醒。: The leak was covered with a patch. From that night on, someone always slept with an arm around Lucky — if he twitched, that man woke.
strings.潮汕口音的普通话，爱叫人“后生仔”“阿弟”，一紧张就念叨“老天保佑”。: Mandarin with a Chaoshan accent, calls everyone "lad" and "little brother", and mutters "God help us" whenever he gets nervous.
strings.火箭尖啸着蹿上夜空。: The rocket screamed up into the night sky.
strings.火箭尖啸着蹿上夜空，炸开一团红光，挂在降落伞下慢慢飘落。: The rocket screamed up into the night sky, burst into a red flare, and drifted down slowly under its parachute.
strings.火箭拖着白烟蹿上了天。: The rocket climbed into the sky trailing white smoke.
strings.灯光没有转向，渐渐沉到了海平线下面。: The lights did not turn. They sank slowly below the horizon.
strings.烧糊涂的人说的话，当不得真: A man that far gone with fever — don't believe a word he says
strings.热带的太阳：篷布下面闷热，但能遮阳；在篷外钓鱼、瞭望、驶帆的人要承受海面的强烈日: The tropical sun: under the tarpaulin it is stifling, but the canvas keeps the sun off. Stay soaked in salt water long enough and saltwater sores come; the weaker a man gets, the worse they rot.
strings.热心、爱笑、信上帝，嘴一刻也不停。见过太多海上的事，知道自己的小船能做什么、不能: Warm, quick to laugh, a believer, and never stops talking. He has seen too much at sea; he knows what his little boat can and cannot do, and on that he will not give an inch.
strings.照手册做：白天衣服一直浸着海水: Do it by the manual: keep your clothes soaked in seawater all day
strings.照手册办：今天除了老潘和孩子，谁都不喝水: By the manual: today no one drinks but Old Pan and the boy
strings.狂风卷着暴雨，浪头比筏子高出好几米。筏子被一次次抛上浪尖，又摔进浪谷。: The gale drove the rain ahead of it, and the waves stood meters above the raft. It was thrown up onto one crest after another and slammed down into the troughs.
strings.现在拿出来，谁都会盯上它: Bring it out now and every eye will be on it
strings.生鱼也是饭，吐了就再咽: Raw fish is still food. Throw it up, swallow it down.
strings.生鱼的汁液里有淡水，可那滋味……: There is fresh water in the juice of raw fish. The taste, though…
strings.用一口水堵住他的嘴；你会更渴: One mouthful of water to shut him up; you will be thirstier for it
strings.用信号镜对准它的驾驶台晃: Flash the signal mirror at its bridge
strings.用信号镜对着飞机晃: Flash the signal mirror at the plane
strings.用刀叉大鱼: Spear the big fish with the knife
strings.用急救包把伤口重新包严: Re-dress the wound and bind it tight with the first-aid kit
strings.用急救包重新清创、加压包扎: Clean the wound again and pressure-bandage it with the first-aid kit
strings.用掉 1 份急救用品；血能止住，鲨鱼也会少一些: Use 1 first-aid item; the bleeding stops, and there will be fewer sharks
strings.用掉 1 份补漏工具；搂着它的人一夜都别想睡踏实: Use 1 patch-kit item; whoever holds the dog won't sleep soundly all night
strings.用救生索把 {actor} 绑在扶手绳上: Tie {actor} to the grabline with the lifeline
strings.用桨狠狠砸它的鼻子: Hit it hard on the nose with the oar
strings.用海水冲洗，把伤腿架高，省下急救包: Rinse it with seawater, prop the bad leg up, and save the first-aid kit
strings.用湿衣服把皮肤都裹起来，白天不出篷布: Wrap every inch of skin in wet cloth and stay under the canopy all day
strings.用罐头铁皮磨一个钩子: Grind a hook out of a tin can
strings.用风箱式打气筒给瘪下去的浮胎打气，再顺着气泡找漏点，用堵漏锥和修补片堵上（每堵一: Pump up the soft buoyancy tube with the bellows pump, then follow the bubbles to find the leak and plug it with a plug and a patch (each leak plugged uses 1 patch-kit item). The raft leaks every day; the more leaks, the faster it goes soft.
strings.瘦、黑、话多，对什么都好奇，越害怕嘴越硬。在厨房给大厨打了一个月下手，把阿杰当亲: Skinny, dark, talks too much, curious about everything, and the more frightened he gets the tougher he talks. He spent a month helping the cook in the galley, treats Jake like a brother, and the yellow dog on the ship follows him everywhere. He still refuses to believe his uncle never got off the ship; he keeps saying his uncle swims like a fish and must be on another raft.
strings.白天不够亮，可渔船上整天都有人盯着海面；信号弹只剩 {res.flares}: Not bright enough by day, but there is always someone on a fishing boat watching the sea; only {res.flares} flares left
strings.白天不如夜里醒目，但能升到三百米高；信号弹只剩 {res.flares}: Less striking by day than by night, but it climbs to 300 m; only {res.flares} flares left
strings.白天最醒目，但风大时烟会被吹散；只有 {res.smoke}: Most visible by day, but a hard wind scatters the smoke; only {res.smoke} left
strings.白天最醒目；风大会吹散: Most visible by day; a hard wind scatters it
strings.白天的红光不够亮，但驾驶台上的人也许正好在看；信号弹只剩 {res.flares: The red light isn't bright enough by day, but someone on the bridge might be looking right at it; only {res.flares} flares left
strings.白天，衣服在海里涮一遍，拧个半干再穿上。筏子里一股咸腥味。: By day, rinse your clothes in the sea, wring them half dry, and put them back on. The raft smells of salt and fish.
strings.皮肤少受罪，但汗要多出很多: Your skin suffers less, but you sweat a great deal more.
strings.省一部分水，疮也少长一些: Saves part of the water, and there will be fewer sores.
strings.省下信号弹——它太远了，等下一艘更近的: Save the flare — that ship's too far off. Wait for a closer one.
strings.省着力气，等它们自己过来: Save your strength. Let them come to you.
strings.看西边那片云，像马尾巴——明天有风。: Look at that cloud in the west, the one like a horse's tail — wind tomorrow.
strings.瞭望的人突然喊起来：东边漂过来一只簸箕一样的竹编圆筐船，里面瘫着一个黑瘦的男人，: The lookout suddenly shouts: a bamboo basket boat, round as a winnowing basket, is drifting in from the east. A thin, dark man lies slumped inside it, waving weakly toward them. One of those little basket boats the Vietnamese fishing crews carry — cracked open, half under water. He keeps repeating one word: "Nước… nước…" The raft is rated for eight. There are {present} aboard already.
strings.硬气、话少、护着年轻人，疼得再厉害也只是哼一声。: Tough, close-mouthed, protective of the younger ones. However much it hurts, he never gives more than a grunt.
strings.神志恍惚，下水游向幻觉中的陆地: Delirious, he goes into the water and swims toward land that isn't there.
strings.私藏的东西会被充公，他会恨你: What he's hidden will be confiscated, and he'll hate you for it.
strings.第二天早上，{actor} 和大厨谁也没提昨晚的事。: The next morning, {actor} and the cook said nothing about the night before.
strings.等回去了，我要跟我们班的人讲，我见过鲨鱼，这——么长。: "When we get back I'm telling my whole class. I saw a shark, and it was thiiis long."
strings.筏子上的人能伸伸腿；你会被泡得发白，水下有什么谁也说不准: The people on the raft get to stretch their legs; you'll soak white, and there's no telling what's down there.
strings.筏子会好受一些，可扔掉的东西就再也找不回来了: The raft will ride easier, but whatever you throw away is gone for good.
strings.筏子宽松一些，水也少分一份；海上的老规矩是见人就救: A little more room on the raft, and one less share of water to split; but the old rule of the sea is that you save anyone you find.
strings.筏子宽松了，水也多出一份；这件事你们要背一辈子: More room on the raft, and an extra share of water; you'll carry this for the rest of your lives.
strings.筏子离新加坡—香港主航道有多近。越近，每天路过的船越多。季风和海流在把筏子往东北: How close the raft is to the Singapore–Hong Kong shipping lane. The closer it drifts, the more ships pass each day. The monsoon and the current are pushing the raft northeast.
strings.筏子软塌塌地陷在浪里，上层浮胎瘪了一大半，篷布的拱架也塌了下来，海水一浪一浪地往: The raft sags soft into the swell, the upper buoyancy tube more than half flat, the canopy frame caved in, the sea pouring in with every wave. At this rate, in another day or two there'll be nothing left of it but a sheet of rubber, floating.
strings.筏子里扭成一团，差点翻过去。泵被抢了回来，钱卫东捂着胳膊，冷冷地看着每一个人。: The raft twisted into a knot and nearly capsized. The pump was taken back. Victor Qian held his arm and looked coldly at every one of them.
strings.筏子里有：十二升淡水、一包压缩干粮、四发火箭降落伞信号、两个烟雾信号、一面信号镜: In the raft: 12 L of fresh water, a packet of compressed rations, four parachute rocket flares, two smoke signals, a signal mirror, a fishing kit, a first-aid kit and a patch kit. And a hand-pump desalinator — cracked when the raft was launched. The chief engineer says it might be repairable.
strings.筏子额定八个人，现在已经挤满了。浮胎被压得只比水面高出一拃，浪稍微大一点就往里灌: The raft is rated for eight, and it is packed full. The buoyancy tubes ride a hand's breadth above the water, and any real swell comes over the side; everyone sits hugging their knees, unable to straighten their legs. In the Second World War, men in lifeboats worked out a way: those still strong enough took turns going into the water, holding the lifeline, soaking for hours to lighten the boat.
strings.筏底下咚、咚地响——一只脸盆大的绿海龟正用背甲蹭着浮胎，像是在蹭痒。它就在伸手够: Thump. Thump. Something is knocking under the raft — a green turtle the size of a washbasin, scraping its shell along the buoyancy tube as if it were scratching an itch. It is within arm's reach.
strings.筏底下聚的鱼越多，跟来的鲨鱼越多；血腥味和剖鱼的内脏更会把它们招来。它们会撞筏、: The more fish gather under the raft, the more sharks follow them; blood in the water and gutted innards draw them in faster still. They ram the raft and bite the tubes, and the ones in the water, or with a hand over the side, are in the worst danger.
strings.算了，袋子本来就漏；以后水袋挂在领头人身边: Forget it — the bag leaked anyway. From now on the water bag hangs beside the leader.
strings.精明、尖刻，看不起“驾驶台上那帮人”；有真本事，也爱拿本事讲条件；一被指责就立刻: Shrewd, sharp-tongued, and contemptuous of "the men on the bridge." He has real skill and he bargains with it; the moment he is blamed, he passes the blame straight on. He has decided the sinking was the captain's fault.
strings.红光在晨雾里一闪就没了。渔船没有转向。: The red light flashed once in the morning mist and was gone. The fishing boat did not turn.
strings.红光淹没在了渔船雪白的灯光里，没有任何回应。: The red light drowned in the fishing boat's white glare. Nothing came back.
strings.红光照亮了半边天，又慢慢熄灭了。那串灯光还在不紧不慢地往前走。: The red light lit half the sky, then slowly died. The string of lights went on, unhurried.
strings.红色的光球挂在半空慢慢往下落。飞机没有转弯，嗡嗡声越来越远。: The red ball hung in the air and sank slowly. The plane did not turn. The drone of its engines faded.
strings.给他一口水，让他留在筐船里，拴在筏尾: Give him a mouthful of water, leave him in the basket boat, and tow it behind the raft.
strings.给老潘擦擦汗，让他别说了: Wipe Old Pan's forehead and tell him to stop talking.
strings.绿海龟在筏子边上又蹭了一会儿，慢悠悠地游走了。: The green turtle scraped along the raft a while longer, then swam slowly away.
strings.罗德尔后来上了马尼拉的电视新闻。主持人问他当时怕不怕，他说怕，油只够回家；可是“: Rodel was on the television news in Manila afterward. The anchor asked if he had been afraid. He said yes — he'd only had enough fuel to get home. But "men of the sea look after men of the sea." That Christmas, a parcel arrived from China. Inside was a new marine radio.
strings.罗德尔回到马辛洛克以后，再也没往那么远的海上去过。镇上的人问起那只橘红色的筏子，: After Rodel got back to Masinloc, he never went that far out to sea again. When people in town asked about the orange liferaft, he always crossed himself and said, "God bless them."
strings.罗德尔在几米外比划了半天，用绳子甩过来一桶水，又在一块木板上刻下了筏子的方位。“: Rodel gestured and waved for a long while from a few meters off, then sent a bucket of water across on a line and carved the raft's position into a plank. "Masinloc — two days! Coast Guard! I promise!" The engine noise slowly faded.
strings.罗德尔把船上剩下的半桶水和一串鱼干都留给了他们，自己只留了一瓶。“Two day: Rodel gave them the half bucket of water still left on his boat and the string of dried fish, keeping only one bottle for himself. "Two days. Pray," he said.
strings.罗德尔的邦卡船是第三天傍晚突突地开进马辛洛克港的。他没去卸鱼，先跑去了海岸警卫队: Rodel's bangka chugged into Masinloc harbor at dusk on the third day. He never unloaded his fish — he went straight to the Coast Guard. A plane and a white patrol boat searched that stretch of sea for two days from the position he gave. Those who came home alive: {survivors}. Those who did not live to see it: {dead}. The Philippine and the Chinese papers both ran the story, with the same photograph — Rodel in his boat, thumbs up to the camera.
strings.罗德尔的邦卡船那天下午消失在东北边的海平线上。他有没有把消息带到，后来谁也说不清: Rodel's bangka vanished over the northeastern horizon that afternoon. Whether he ever carried the word to anyone, no one could say afterward — the people in Masinloc said the wind came up again those days.
strings.翻筏落水后遭鲨鱼袭击: Taken by sharks after the raft capsized
strings.老头把邦卡船靠了过来，把缆绳甩到了筏子上。他叫罗德尔，从马辛洛克来，打了三十年鱼: The old man brought his bangka alongside and threw a line onto the raft. His name was Rodel, from Masinloc; he had fished for thirty years. First he handed over a bucket of fresh water, then a pot of cold rice and a string of dried fish.
strings.老潘又昏睡过去了，再也问不出什么。钱卫东冷冷地说：“烧糊涂的人讲的话，侬也信？”: Old Pan sank back into sleep, and nothing more could be got out of him. Victor Qian said coldly, "A man raving with fever, and you believe him?"
strings.老潘喝了水，闭着眼睛说了一声：谢了。: Old Pan drank, closed his eyes, and said, "Thanks."
strings.老潘把离他最近的人叫到身边，声音轻得几乎听不见：“别再把水往我嘴里倒了。我这条腿: Old Pan called the one nearest him close. His voice was barely audible. "Stop pouring water into my mouth. I know what this leg is. Save it — save it for you young ones."
strings.老潘没能回去。漳州老家的人只知道他跑了四十二年船，最后一趟没回来。他们不知道，沉: Old Pan did not make it home. In Zhangzhou they knew only that he had sailed for forty-two years, and that on his last voyage he did not come back. They never knew that on the night the ship went down, he floated in the water and pushed the others onto the raft, one by one.
strings.老潘没能回来。阿杰把师傅那双破了洞的劳保手套带回了雷州，挂在自家渔船的舵把上。回: Old Pan did not come back. Jake carried his master's work gloves, holes and all, home to Leizhou and hung them on the tiller of the family boat. The first thing he did ashore was learn to swim.
strings.老潘没说话，自己撑着胳膊挪到了筏子最边上。整整一天，筏子里谁也没再开口。: Old Pan said nothing. He propped himself up on his arms and moved to the very edge of the raft. For the whole day, no one in the raft spoke again.
strings.老潘活了下来，阿杰没有。他把阿杰的那件救生衣带回了雷州，交给了阿杰的妈。后来每年: Old Pan lived. Jake did not. He carried Jake's life jacket back to Leizhou and gave it to Jake's mother. Every Qingming after that, he went and sat at Jake's grave and lit two cigarettes — one for himself, one for Jake.
strings.老潘点点头，像是松了一口气，把脸转向了篷布。: Old Pan nodded, as if a weight had come off him, and turned his face to the canopy.
strings.老潘的那一盖水，从此只倒半盖。: From then on, Old Pan's capful of water was only ever half a cap.
strings.老潘腿上留下了一道蜈蚣一样的疤。第二年夏天，湛江的海滨浴场里常能看见一个瘸腿老头: The wound on Old Pan's leg left a scar like a centipede. The next summer, a lame old man was often to be seen at the Zhanjiang beach, one hand under a young man's belly, bellowing: "Head down! Don't stick your ass up!" — Jake learned to swim after all.
strings.老潘腿上的伤口发着炎，烧了一整天，一直在说胡话。夜里，他忽然攥住 {actor}: The wound on Old Pan's leg was infected. He burned with fever all day, talking nonsense. At night he suddenly seized {actor}'s wrist and mumbled, "…Old Qian, that night… he stank of drink… rang the engine room three times, nobody answered…"
strings.老潘腿上的纱布又被血浸透了。血水顺着筏底的积水流出去，海面上洇开一片淡红。阿杰说: The gauze on Old Pan's leg was soaked through with blood again. It ran out with the water sloshing in the bottom of the raft and spread in a pale red stain across the sea. Jake said something had rubbed against the underside of the raft several times in the night.
strings.老潘被抬上了邦卡船。他回头看了一眼筏子，冲阿杰摆了摆手，什么也没说。: Old Pan was lifted aboard the bangka. He looked back once at the raft, gave Jake a small wave, and said nothing.
strings.老潘那一份被分给了别人。他没说什么，只是把脸转了过去。: Old Pan's share was given to someone else. He said nothing. He just turned his face away.
strings.老黄是被推下筏子的。他那么胖，在水里浮得比谁都高，一直漂在筏子后面，扑腾着，喊着: Old Huang was pushed off the raft. He was so fat he floated higher than any of them, drifting behind the raft, thrashing and shouting a name, until dark.
strings.老黄死在了筏子上。他走的那天早上还在讲笑话，讲到一半睡着了，就再也没醒。活下来的: Old Huang died on the raft. That morning he had still been telling a joke; he fell asleep halfway through it and never woke. Everyone who lived remembers how the joke began. No one can remember the end.
strings.肉够吃好几天，血能当水喝；它的爪子可能抓破浮胎: Enough meat for days, and blood you can drink; but its claws could tear the buoyancy tube.
strings.胶东口音，说话慢，一字一顿，爱说“听我的”“按规矩来”“我是船长”。: A Jiaodong accent. He speaks slowly, one word at a time, and likes to say "Listen to me," "By the book," "I'm the captain."
strings.能做两三个钩子；可以后夜里就没有手电了: You could make two or three hooks; but after that there'd be no flashlight at night.
strings.能升到三百米高空，红光燃烧四十秒。夜里二三十海里外都能看见，白天就暗淡多了。: It climbs to 300 m and burns red for forty seconds. At night it can be seen from twenty or thirty nautical miles away; in daylight it is far dimmer.
strings.能密封装水的东西一共能装多少升。雨下得再大，装不下的水只能当场喝掉。: How many liters all the watertight containers hold between them. However hard it rains, whatever won't fit has to be drunk on the spot.
strings.能干活的人倒下了，大家都完: If the ones who can work go down, they are all finished.
strings.能把筏子撑起来，但每个人都会累垮、渴得更厉害: It keeps the raft up, but everyone will be wrecked and thirstier for it.
strings.能把筏子的漂流方向讲清楚，搜救才有准头；可走的那个人，等于先一步活了下来: Someone who can describe exactly how the raft is drifting gives the search a real chance of finding them; but whoever goes has, in effect, survived first.
strings.能省下一点淡水；他会更快地垮下去: You save a little fresh water; he goes downhill faster.
strings.能省下好几升水，身体也会更早开始节水；今晚会渴得睡不着: You save several liters of water, and the body starts conserving sooner; tonight you'll be too thirsty to sleep.
strings.能舒服好几个小时——之后会渴得更厉害: It feels good for a few hours — then you're thirstier than before.
strings.能让它见血——可血会招来更多的鲨鱼；刀也可能扎破自己的筏子: You could draw blood — but blood brings more sharks, and the knife could puncture your own raft.
strings.航海学院后来给“弃船求生”那一课加了两个课时。教官每次讲到最后，都要停下来说一句: The maritime academy later added two class hours to the "Abandon Ship and Survival" course. Every time the instructor reached the end, he would stop and say one thing: "Every line in that manual was paid for with someone's life."
strings.航海学院大四学生，跟船实习半年，在驾驶台上跟班值守。她是筏子上唯一系统学过海上求: A senior at the maritime academy, six months at sea on her internship, standing watches on the bridge. She is the only one on the raft who has properly studied sea survival and first aid; when they abandoned ship, she also grabbed a SART radar transponder off the bridge.
strings.船上的大厨，五十出头，胖，爱讲笑话，全船人都叫他“老黄”。他的亲外甥阿杰也在这条: The ship's cook. Past fifty, fat, fond of a joke — the whole crew calls him "Old Huang." His sister's son, Jake, is on the ship too; he pulled strings to get him aboard.
strings.船长一个字也没说。钱卫东骂了一句，最后还是把泵装了回去。: The captain didn't say a word. Victor Qian swore once, then put the pump back in place after all.
strings.船长扶着软梯，把每一个人送上去。最后，他回头看了一眼那只瘪了一半的筏子，才抓住了: The captain held the rope ladder steady and sent each of them up. At the end, he looked back once at the half-deflated raft, and only then took hold of the ladder himself.
strings.船长接过 SART，掂了掂，说：“等我的命令再开。”: The captain took the SART, weighed it in his hand, and said, "Don't switch it on until I give the word."
strings.船长没说话。钱卫东把泵装回去，第一次在筏子上露出了笑。: The captain said nothing. Victor Qian put the pump back, and for the first time on the raft, he smiled.
strings.船长的秘密会被揭开: The captain's secret will come out
strings.船长的秘密可能会被揭开: The captain's secret may come out
strings.船长看着苏晓雯，说：“是你签的字。”: The captain looked at Wendy Su and said, "You signed it."
strings.船长醒了，正看着 {actor} 手里的日志。: The captain was awake, looking at the log in {actor}'s hands.
strings.船长随身药盒里的几片阿莫西林，加上急救包里一支抗菌药膏。: A few amoxicillin tablets from the pillbox the captain carries, plus a tube of antibacterial ointment from the first-aid kit.
strings.船长靠在浮胎上睡着了。他怀里那个从不离身的塑料袋滑了出来，隔着塑料能看见里面的硬: The captain had fallen asleep against the buoyancy tube. The plastic bag he never let out of his arms had slipped loose, and through the plastic they could see the hardcover notebook inside — the log of the Haichuan 9.
strings.苏晓雯一夜没合眼。天亮时，她突然开口：“既然要说，那就都说清楚。”所有人都转过头: Wendy Su did not sleep all night. At first light she spoke up suddenly: "If we're going to say it, then let's say all of it." Everyone turned to look at her.
strings.苏晓雯从救生衣口袋里掏出一个黄色的圆筒——弃船时从驾驶台上抓的 SART 雷达应: Wendy Su took a yellow cylinder out of her life jacket pocket — the SART radar transponder she had grabbed off the bridge when they abandoned ship. Switched on, it puts a string of blips on the radar screens of ships nearby; but its battery only lasts four days on standby.
strings.苏晓雯把 SART 用塑料袋包好，塞回了口袋。: Wendy Su wrapped the SART in a plastic bag and pushed it back into her pocket.
strings.苏晓雯按时毕业，拿到三副证书，上了一条远洋集装箱船。那张检查表的事，她再也没对任: Wendy Su graduated on time, got her third mate's ticket, and joined an ocean-going container ship. She never mentioned the checklist to anyone again. Whenever it was her turn to inspect the EPIRB, she took the release unit off, wiped it clean, put it back, and signed — every stroke slow and deliberate.
strings.苏晓雯没能回去。她的学生证一直装在救生衣口袋的密封袋里，后来被送回了航海学院。那: Wendy Su did not make it back. Her student ID stayed in the sealed bag in her life jacket pocket, and was later sent back to the maritime academy. In that year's graduation photograph, there is an empty place in the middle of the front row.
strings.苏晓雯被推下筏子的时候，手里还攥着那本求生手册。手册第一页印着一行字：任何情况下: When Wendy Su was pushed off the raft, she was still clutching the survival manual. On the first page was a printed line: Under no circumstances is anyone on the raft to be abandoned.
strings.苏晓雯跟着菲律宾渔船先走了。在马辛洛克的海岸警卫队，她把筏子的漂流方向、海流和风: Wendy Su left first, with the Philippine fishing boat. At the Coast Guard station in Masinloc she filled a chart with the raft's drift, the currents and the wind, walked them through it point by point in English, and only when she was done did she cry. The search aircraft flew off that page.
strings.苏晓雯跪在积水里，把伤口里的碎屑一点点挑出来，再一层层压紧。老潘咬着救生衣的带子: Wendy Su knelt in the water sloshing in the bottom of the raft, picking the debris out of the wound bit by bit, then pressing the dressing down layer by layer. Old Pan bit down on a life jacket strap and made no sound at all.
strings.英语和他加禄语掺着说，开口闭口“Sir”“Ma'am”，一惊一乍就喊“Susma: He mixes English and Tagalog, says "Sir" and "Ma'am" at every turn, and yells "Susmaryosep!" at the slightest thing.
strings.菲律宾三描礼士省马辛洛克镇的渔民，和女婿开着一条两侧架着竹制浮杆的邦卡船出海，在: A fisherman from Masinloc, in Zambales province, the Philippines. He goes out with his son-in-law on a bangka with bamboo outriggers on both sides, and has fished these waters for thirty years. He speaks a little English. Aboard: a bucket of fresh water, a pot of rice, a string of dried fish, and a phone that loses signal the moment he is out of sight of land.
strings.菲律宾海岸警卫队的飞机在罗德尔报的方位附近找了三天。筏子早已漂出了那片海，飞机从: Aircraft of the Philippine Coast Guard searched for three days around the position Rodel gave. The raft had long since drifted out of that stretch of sea; the plane passed twenty nautical miles from it.
strings.落水后遭鲨鱼袭击: Attacked by sharks after going into the water
strings.落水时被鲨鱼咬伤: shark bite going into the water
strings.落水时被鲨鱼皮擦伤: shark-skin graze going into the water
strings.血腥味把鲨鱼引了过来。它冲着 {actor} 手里那条还在挣扎的鱼扑上来，一口咬: The smell of blood brought the shark in. It lunged for the fish still thrashing in {actor}'s hand and sank its teeth into the arm.
strings.补上漏点，夜里找个人一直搂着它: Patch the leak, and have someone hold the dog in their arms all night.
strings.被夹在船壳和筏子之间: crush injury between the hull and the raft
strings.被救上去的是：{survivors}。没能等到这一天的是：{dead}。在后来的: Those pulled up alive: {survivors}. Those who didn't live to see this day: {dead}. In the maritime inquiry that followed, every statement lined up: how many days they drifted, how the fresh water was shared, who died on which day. Only one thing went into nobody's account: the Vietnamese fisherman in the bamboo basket boat who reached out a hand to them. There is a rule at sea older than any law. You see a man in the water, you pull him out.
strings.被缆绳勒破的手掌: palm torn open by a line
strings.要一升淡水，一小口一小口地喝下去: Ask for 1 L of fresh water and drink it in small sips.
strings.要是冤枉了他，他会记一辈子: Wrong him once and he'll remember it for the rest of his life.
strings.观星定位、调整海锚: Take a fix on the stars, adjust the sea anchor
strings.规矩没改。小满舔了舔罐头盖的边，又把它递了回去。: The rule held. Danny licked the edge of the can lid and passed it back.
strings.认真、守规矩，紧张时话特别多，爱引用教材；对船长又敬又怕。心里压着一件事，越来越: Serious, by the book, talks too much when she's nervous, loves quoting the manual; respects the captain and fears him in equal measure. Something is pressing on her, and it's getting harder to carry.
strings.让伤得最重的老潘和孩子跟他走: Take Old Pan, hurt worst, and the boy with him
strings.让老潘自己挪到筏子边上去，别把大家都拖累死: Let Old Pan drag himself to the edge of the raft, before he takes everyone down with him
strings.让那个越南人下去泡着——是他让筏子超了载: Put the Vietnamese man in the water; he's the one who overloaded the raft
strings.让阮文雄抱着油壶游过去: Let Nguyen Van Hung swim for it with the oil can
strings.记在心里，谁也不说: Keep it in mind and tell no one
strings.试了三次才翻过来。所有人在水里泡了快一个小时，爬回筏子时连手都抬不起来。: It took three tries to right the raft. Everyone had been in the water nearly an hour, and when they crawled back aboard they couldn't lift their arms.
strings.话到嘴边，又咽了回去: The words came to his lips, and he swallowed them again.
strings.说出来又能怎样: What good would it do to say it?
strings.说出沉船前一天，船长在卫星电话里回绝了绕航: Tell them that the day before the sinking, the captain had turned down the detour on the satphone
strings.说是二副负责的——他没能上筏: Say the second mate was responsible; he never made it onto the raft
strings.说是释放器的质量问题，检查一直都正常: Say it was a bad release unit; the inspections had always been clean
strings.说越南话，靠手势比划；唯一会说的中文是一句发音古怪的“谢谢”。: Speaks Vietnamese, gets by on gestures; the only Chinese he can manage is a strangely pronounced "thank you."
strings.请他靠过来，两条船拴在一起过一夜: Ask him to come alongside, tie the two boats together for the night
strings.谁下得去手？: Who could bring themselves to do it?
strings.谁也不走：请他回去报信，把水和鱼干留下: No one goes with him: send him back to raise the alarm; the water and the dried fish stay on the raft
strings.谁抓得住软梯谁先上: First one to catch the ladder goes up
strings.调查报告把事故原因写成了“货物液化”，驾驶台和机舱，谁都没被点名。钱卫东拿了一笔: The report put the cause down as "cargo liquefaction." The bridge, the engine room, nobody was named. Victor Qian took a small settlement and shipped out again. On night watch he always set his alarm to ring every half hour.
strings.调查组来了三趟，才把邓小满的名字补进报告，写在“其他人员”一栏。他被他妈关在家里: It took three visits from the inquiry before Danny Deng's name was added to the report, in the "other personnel" column. His mother kept him shut in the house for a whole summer. Three years later he was admitted to Dalian Maritime University to study marine engineering. His mother cried all night and could not stop him.
strings.谢谢。谢谢。（他双手接过那半盖水，连着弯了好几次腰。）: Thank you. Thank you. (He took the half cap of water in both hands and bowed again and again.)
strings.货轮在海平线上停住了，过了一会儿，船头慢慢朝这边转了过来。: The freighter stopped dead on the horizon, and after a while her bow began to come slowly around toward them.
strings.货轮拉响了汽笛，船头朝着橙色的烟柱转了过来——他们看见了！: The freighter sounded her horn and swung her bow toward the column of orange smoke. They'd been seen!
strings.货轮拉响了汽笛，长长的一声，船头慢慢转了过来——他们看见了！: The freighter sounded her horn, one long blast, and her bow came slowly around. They'd been seen!
strings.货轮驾驶台上有灯光回闪了三下——他们看见了！: A light on the freighter's bridge flashed three times. They'd been seen!
strings.费力气，尸体的气味会招鲨鱼；可孩子会记得你们怎么对他叔叔: Hard work, and the stink of a corpse will draw sharks; but the boy will remember how you treated his uncle
strings.费工夫，未必磨得成: Takes time, and it may come to nothing
strings.费时间费力气，但稳当: Takes time and effort, but it's sound
strings.趁下雨把集水槽、水袋、空罐头、塑料袋全摆开接水，再一点点灌进能密封的容器。雨越大: When the rain comes, lay out the gutters, the water bags, the empty cans, the plastic bags, all of it, and then pour what you catch, little by little, into anything that will seal. The harder it rains the more you catch; but once the containers are full there is nowhere left to put it.
strings.趁残骸还没漂散，派人下水捞漂浮物: Send someone over the side for floating gear before the wreckage drifts apart
strings.趁清晨太阳还不毒，坐在篷布出入口钓筏底下的鱼。鱼群越大收获越多，钓鱼的人能把鱼肉: While the morning sun is still soft, sit in the canopy opening and fish beneath the raft. The bigger the school the bigger the haul, and whoever is fishing can wrap the flesh in cloth and wring out the juice to drink. But the blood of gutting draws sharks; a big one can take hook and line together; and a shark may come straight at the fish in your hands.
strings.越南广义省李山岛人，跟着一条木壳渔船出海钓金枪鱼，钓了二十多年。台风「海葵」打翻: From Ly Son Island, Quang Ngai Province, Vietnam. He fished tuna off a wooden-hulled boat for more than twenty years. Typhoon Haikui rolled their vessel over; he climbed into the bamboo basket boat they carried aboard and drifted two days and two nights. He doesn't speak a word of Chinese.
strings.趴在篷布出入口，轮流盯着海平线：船、飞机、漂浮物。有人瞭望，路过的船才不会被错过: Lie in the canopy opening and take turns watching the horizon: ships, aircraft, debris. With a lookout, a passing ship won't be missed; but someone has to sit out in the sun.
strings.跑了三十二年船，当了十一年船长，在公司里出了名的“稳”。弃船时他最后一个离开驾驶: Thirty-two years at sea, eleven of them as master, and in the company he was known for one word: steady. When they abandoned ship he was the last man off the bridge, a plastic bag clutched to his chest. He still won't let it go.
strings.跳下去，游过去: Jump in and swim for it
strings.跳海时划破的脚底: gashed sole from jumping into the sea
strings.过了二十分钟，那串灯光慢慢转了个方向，朝筏子开了过来。: Twenty minutes later the string of lights swung slowly around and came for the raft.
strings.过了半个小时，一束探照灯从那片灯光里伸了过来，在海面上慢慢扫着。: Half an hour later a searchlight reached out of that cluster of lights and began to sweep the water.
strings.过路的船大多开着雷达；电只够四天: Most passing ships run their radar; the power will only last four days
strings.还按六成——他个子小，用不了那么多: Keep him at sixty percent; he's small, he doesn't need that much
strings.这一天，有一艘货轮从十来海里外经过。筏子上没有人看见它。: That day a freighter passed ten nautical miles off. No one on the raft saw it.
strings.这不关你的事: Tell him it's none of his business.
strings.这句话说出口就收不回来了: Once those words are out, they can't be called back.
strings.这句话，筏子里不止一个人听见了。: More than one person on the raft heard it.
strings.远离航道: Well clear of the shipping lane
strings.逼船长把话说清楚: Make the captain say it straight
strings.遛了两个钟头，鱼线还是在浮胎的边上磨断了。: Two hours of trolling, and the line still frayed through against the buoyancy tube.
strings.那天夜里机舱里的十几分钟，最后还是被写进了调查报告。钱卫东的轮机长证书被吊销了。: In the end, those ten minutes or so down in the engine room that night were written into the investigation report. Victor Qian lost his chief engineer's certificate. He went back to Ningbo and became a fitter in a shipyard, and stayed one for more than a decade. Everyone at the yard said Old Qian never touched a drop. Not even beer.
strings.那天夜里，阮文雄悄悄下了海，没有人知道他游向了哪里。李山岛的老渔民说，在海上漂的: That night Nguyen Van Hung slipped quietly into the sea, and no one knew where he swam. The old fishermen of Ly Son Island say that a man adrift, so long as he can still see the stars, knows the way home.
strings.那条小船装不下这么多人: That little boat can't hold this many people.
strings.那条船头画着两只蓝眼睛的越南渔船，把筏子拖到了船边。船上的人都认识阮文雄——在李: The Vietnamese boat with two blue eyes painted on its bow towed the raft alongside. Everyone aboard knew Nguyen Van Hung; on Ly Son Island every seafaring family is kin. They shared water and rice porridge and gave up bunks below: {survivors}. Those who didn't live to see this day: {dead}. Three days later at Da Nang the Chinese consulate took them in. The skipper said something in Vietnamese as they left. Nobody understood, but they all nodded.
strings.那片灯光是一支从北海来的灯光围网船队。渔民们把筏子拖到船边，一个一个地把人抱上了: The lights belonged to a light-seine fleet out of Beihai. The fishermen towed the raft alongside and lifted them onto the deck one by one: {survivors}. Those who didn't live to see this day: {dead}. The skipper said they had fished these waters for twenty years and had never seen anyone drift in from so far out.
strings.那艘船上有一盏灯回闪了：短、短、短——他们看见了！: A lamp on that ship flashed back: short, short, short. They'd been seen!
strings.那艘船没有停。也许它的雷达根本没开在那个量程上。: The ship didn't stop. Maybe her radar was never set to that range.
strings.那艘船的探照灯亮了，一道白光在海面上扫来扫去，最后停在了筏子上——他们看见了！: The ship's searchlight came on, a white beam sweeping back and forth across the water until it stopped on the raft. They'd been seen!
strings.那艘过路的货轮把筏子拖到了舷边。活着爬上甲板的是：{survivors}。没能等: The passing freighter towed the raft in against her side. Those who climbed aboard alive: {survivors}. Those who didn't live to see this day: {dead}. The second mate said afterward that he had already handed over his watch, and looked once more at the sea on his way off the bridge.
strings.郑国栋是第一个离开那片海的人——坐着一条菲律宾渔船。后来在每一份笔录里，他都写：: Gordon Zheng was the first to leave that stretch of sea, aboard a Philippine fishing boat. In every statement afterward he wrote the same line: "I went back for help." It was true. And every time he wrote it, his pen stopped for a long while.
strings.郑国栋死在了筏子上，到最后也没松开怀里那个塑料袋。航海日志在袋子里泡了十几天，一: Gordon Zheng died on the raft and never let go of the plastic bag against his chest. The logbook soaked inside it for ten-odd days and not one word had run. The investigators made copy after copy of the last pages.
strings.郑国栋的名字刻在了湛江海员纪念碑上，和「海川 9 号」其余二十个人的名字刻在一起: Gordon Zheng's name is cut into the Zhanjiang seafarers' memorial, together with the other twenty men of the Haichuan 9. The stone does not say who decided to run past the edge of the typhoon.
strings.郑国栋被推下筏子的那天夜里起了雾。海事调查报告里，他被写作“弃船后失踪”。他老婆: Fog came up the night Gordon Zheng was pushed off the raft. In the maritime investigation report he is set down as "missing after abandoning ship." His wife sat outside the company gate in Yantai for three months. What she got in the end was a letter of condolence on company letterhead, and a payment.
strings.钓线猛地绷紧，差点把人拽下筏子——一条一米多长的鲯鳅咬了钩，金绿色的身子在浪里翻: The line snapped taut and nearly took a man over the side. A mahi-mahi more than a meter long had taken the hook, its gold-green body thrashing through the swell, five kilos if it was an ounce.
strings.钓鱼剖下来的内脏也不扔了，全塞进一个袋子里，等天黑再远远地抛出去。: Now the guts from gutting fish weren't thrown overboard either; they went into a bag to be flung far out after dark.
strings.钱卫东如愿以偿：调查报告里白纸黑字地写着，船长拒绝了绕航建议。听证会上他发言最多: Victor Qian got what he wanted: the report said it in black and white, the captain had refused the advice to detour. At the hearing he spoke more than anyone, loud when it came to the captain, vague when it came to those ten minutes without power in the engine room. Six months later he was back at sea, chief engineer again.
strings.钱卫东把淡化器的高压泵拆了下来，揣进怀里。“修它的是我，摇它的也是我。”他盯着船: Victor Qian unbolted the desalinator's high-pressure pump and tucked it inside his jacket. "I'm the one who fixed it. I'm the one who cranks it." He stared at the captain. "What really happened the day of the typhoon, you don't tell us straight today, nobody touches this."
strings.钱卫东是被推下筏子的。他在浪里骂了很久，骂船长，骂老天，最后骂的是他自己。他那份: Victor Qian was pushed off the raft. He cursed in the water for a long time, cursed the captain, cursed God, and in the end cursed himself. That accident report of his, the one headed "main engine failure," never got written.
strings.钱卫东没能回去。他那把多用刀被人带回了宁波，交给了他儿子。刀上全是锈，小钳子里还: Victor Qian never made it home. His multitool was carried back to Ningbo and given to his son. It was rust from end to end, and the little pliers still gripped half an O-ring left over from the desalinator.
strings.钱卫东用鱼线和救生索把水袋、干粮、信号弹一样一样拴在扶手绳上，打的全是死结。: Victor Qian lashed the water bags, the rations and the flares to the grabline one by one, with fishing line and lifeline, every knot pulled into a dead knot.
strings.钱卫东的名字刻在了湛江海员纪念碑上。他儿子去拓过一次碑，拓完了，对着那一行字站了: Victor Qian's name is cut into the Zhanjiang seafarers' memorial. His son went once to take a rubbing; when it was done he stood a long time in front of that one line of characters. What happened in the engine room in those ten minutes went down to the bottom of the South China Sea with him.
strings.钱卫东突然当着所有人的面问船长：“EPIRB 的静水释放器每个季度都要检查，它为: In front of everyone, Victor Qian suddenly asked the captain: "The EPIRB's hydrostatic release has to be checked every quarter. Why didn't it float free? Whose signature is on the last inspection?" Wendy Su kept her head down, fingers picking at the rubber of the buoyancy tube.
strings.钱卫东说完这两个字，就把脸埋进了胳膊里。小满看了他很久，一句话也没说，挪回了自己: The moment those two words were out, Victor Qian buried his face in his arms. Danny watched him a long time, said nothing, and moved back to his corner.
strings.铁皮太软，钩子一挂上鱼就直了。: The sheet metal was too soft. A fish took the hook and it straightened right out.
strings.镜子里的光斑在海面上跳来跳去，怎么也套不住那个小黑点。: The spot of light from the mirror skipped across the water and would not settle on the small black dot.
strings.闭上眼睛，让人把自己绑在扶手绳上: Close your eyes and let them tie you to the lifeline
strings.闭着眼睛咽下去: Swallow it with your eyes shut
strings.闽南口音，话很少。: A Minnan accent. He says almost nothing.
strings.阮文雄把油壶抱在胸前，冲大家咧嘴一笑，翻身下了水。: Nguyen Van Hung hugged the oil can to his chest, grinned at them all, and rolled into the water.
strings.阮文雄抱着油壶，一下一下地朝渔船游去，在浪里越变越小，最后看不见了。: Nguyen Van Hung swam for the fishing boat with the oil can against his chest, stroke after stroke, smaller and smaller in the swell, until he was gone.
strings.阮文雄活着回到了李山岛。第二年，湛江收到一张从越南寄来的照片：一条新漆了蓝眼睛的: Nguyen Van Hung made it home alive to Ly Son Island. The next year a photograph arrived in Zhanjiang from Vietnam: a fishing boat freshly painted with blue eyes, and standing in the bow, him, his wife and two children. On the back, a line in Vietnamese. Someone translated it: "The sea belongs to everyone."
strings.阮文雄的筐船终于散了架，一点一点沉了下去。这一回谁也没再说什么，几只手一起把他拖: Nguyen Van Hung's basket boat finally came apart and sank, piece by piece. This time nobody said anything. Several hands hauled him back onto the raft together.
strings.阮文雄站在浮胎上，用越南话一遍一遍地喊，喊到最后只剩下嘶嘶的气声。: Nguyen Van Hung stood up on the buoyancy tube and shouted in Vietnamese, over and over, until all that was left was a hiss of breath.
strings.阮文雄被几只手推过了浮胎。他抓着扶手绳不肯松，有人掰开了他的手指。他在浪里一浮一: Hands pushed Nguyen Van Hung across the buoyancy tube. He gripped the grabline and would not let go, and someone pried his fingers open. He rose and sank in the waves, his hand still reaching for the raft.
strings.防止跳海，但只能等它自己过去: Keeps anyone from going over the side, but all you can do is wait for it to pass
strings.阵雨扫过筏子。篷布的集水槽哗哗地往下淌水，每个人都仰着头喝了个够，又把能装水的东: A squall swept over the raft. Water came rushing down the canopy gutter; everyone tipped their heads back and drank their fill, then filled everything that could hold water.
strings.阿杰一下水就慌了，死死抓着救生索往下沉，是被人揪着头发拖上来的。他根本不会游泳。: Jake panicked the moment he hit the water and sank clutching the lifeline; they hauled him up by the hair. He couldn't swim at all.
strings.阿杰在水里乱抓乱蹬，呛了好几口水，是被人揪着救生衣拖到筏边的——他根本不会游泳。: Jake clawed and kicked at the water, swallowed mouthful after mouthful, and was dragged to the edge of the raft by his life jacket. He couldn't swim at all.
strings.阿杰没能回去。活下来的人说，他最后几天一直趴在筏边看水里的鲯鳅，手里攥着那支绑了: Jake never made it home. The survivors said that in his last days he lay at the edge of the raft watching the mahi-mahi under the water, the knife-lashed oar gripped in his hand, as if he might drive it down at any moment.
strings.阿杰的嘴唇裂开了好几道口子，说话都带着血丝。{actor} 隔着救生衣，摸了摸怀: Jake's lips had split open in several places, and there was blood in his voice. {actor} reached under the life jacket and touched the unopened bottle of mineral water stowed there.
strings.阿杰被推下了筏子。他不会游泳，救生衣的带子也没系紧，在浪里扑腾了几下，就再也没浮: Jake was pushed off the raft. He couldn't swim, and his life jacket wasn't fastened tight; he thrashed a few times in the swell and never came up again.
strings.陈俊杰，大家都叫他阿杰。大厨的亲外甥，在雷州的渔村长大，上船才四个月。年轻、力气: Jake Chen, whom everyone called Jake. The cook's own nephew, raised in a fishing village in Leizhou, only four months aboard. Young, strong, sharp-eyed, a natural with a fishing line. When they abandoned ship, it was he who lay over the edge of the raft and hauled the wounded bosun, Old Pan, up out of the water.
strings.隔这么远，几乎不可能被听见: At this distance, no one will hear it.
strings.隔这么远，几乎不可能被看见: At this distance, no one will see it.
strings.雨是最大的指望：一场热带阵雨，篷布的集水槽能接到好几升水——前提是有东西装，装不: Rain is the great hope: one tropical squall, and the canopy gutter can catch several liters — if you have something to put it in. Whatever won't fit, you drink on the spot. Raw fish juice, bird blood, turtle blood — those are water too. When the hand-pump desalinator was new it gave nearly a liter of fresh water for an hour of pumping; this patched-up one does worse, the membrane fouls the more you pump, and the one pumping sweats.
strings.雷州话夹着普通话，爱说“怕什么”“我来”，急了就骂人。: Leizhou dialect mixed with Mandarin. He likes to say "What's there to be scared of?" and "I'll do it." Push him and he swears.
strings.雷州那个渔村里，阿杰他妈每天傍晚都去码头上坐一会儿。村里人都说，那孩子打小在海边: Back in that fishing village in Leizhou, Jake's mother goes and sits on the pier for a while every evening. Everyone in the village says the boy grew up by the sea — nobody knows he never learned to swim.
strings.顾不了那么多了: No time to worry about that now.
strings.领头人从自己那份里匀他一半: The leader gives him half of his own share.
strings.领头人自己跟他走：“我去搬救兵。”: The leader goes with him himself: "I'll go bring back help."
strings.风暴里，雨水和浪花一起往筏子里灌。顾不上害怕，所有人仰着头接雨，喝到肚子发胀，又: In the storm, rain and spray poured into the raft together. There was no time for fear; everyone tipped their heads back to catch the rain, drank until their bellies were tight, and filled every container that would hold water, one after another.
strings.飞机压低高度，绕着筏子转了一圈，摇了摇机翼——他们看见了！: The plane dropped lower, circled the raft once, and rocked its wings — they'd seen them!
strings.飞机在空中划了一个大弯，朝橙色的烟柱飞了过来——他们看见了！: The plane carved a wide turn in the sky and made for the orange smoke column — they'd seen it!
strings.飞机的机翼闪了一下，它转过来了——他们看见了那道闪光！: The plane's wing flashed once and it turned back toward them — they'd seen the flash!
strings.马上爬回篷布最里面，用浸了海水的衣服擦身降温: Crawl straight back under the canopy and cool down with clothes soaked in seawater.
strings.马达声越来越远，邦卡船变成了海平线上的一个小点。: The engine noise faded farther and farther away, and the bangka shrank to a dot on the horizon.
strings.高压泵的密封圈裂了，膜壳也有一道细缝。修好它，每天就能从海水里压出几升淡水。: The high-pressure pump's seal is split, and the membrane housing has a hairline crack. Fix it and you can press several liters of fresh water out of the sea every day.
strings.鱼线一剪断，那道金绿色的影子就不见了。: The moment the line was cut, the gold-green shape was gone.
strings.鱼线放出去，又收回来，一来一回，遛了整整一个上午。: They let the line run out and reeled it back, out and back, playing the fish all morning long.
strings.鲣鸟在篷顶上站了一下午，傍晚才飞走。有人说，海鸟肯落在筏子上，是来给人指路的。: A booby stood on top of the canopy all afternoon and only flew off at dusk. Someone said sea birds only land on a raft to show people the way.
strings.鲣鸟扑棱棱地飞走了。: The booby took off with a clatter of wings.
strings.鲨鱼会被血腥味和剖鱼的内脏吸引；筏子每天都在漏气，必须有人打气补漏，瘪到底就会沉: Sharks come for blood and fish guts; the raft loses air every day, so someone has to pump and patch it — flat, it sinks. The monsoon and the current are pushing the raft off the shipping lane; shooting the stars, adjusting the sea anchor and sailing can claw a little back — drift northeast and the farther from the lane, the nearer the Filipino fishermen's grounds. The liferaft is rated for eight: packed full, the buoyancy tubes ride a hand's span above the water, every big wave pours in, and nobody can lie flat.
strings.鲨鱼越来越多了，白天也能看见三四片背鳍在筏子周围慢慢地转。有人压低声音说：“是老: There were more sharks every day; even in daylight you could see three or four fins turning slow circles round the raft. Someone said, low: "It's the blood from Old Pan's leg that's bringing them." The raft went quiet.
strings.鲯鳅在筏子里乱蹦，嘴上的鱼钩在浮胎上划开了一道口子。: The mahi-mahi thrashed across the raft, and the hook in its mouth tore a gash in the buoyancy tube.
strings.鸟肉能吃，鸟血能喝；扑空了它就不会再来了: The meat is food and the blood is water; miss your lunge and it won't come back.
strings.鸡同鸭讲，也许能弄明白，也许白费工夫: Like a chicken talking to a duck — maybe you work it out, maybe you waste the effort.
strings.黄德贵再也没上过船。他在汕头老城开了一间卖牛肉粿条的小店，阿杰在店里帮了半年忙，: Derek Huang never went to sea again. He opened a little shop in the old town of Shantou selling beef kway teow; Jake helped out there for six months, then shipped out again. There is a photo on the wall taken aboard the rescue ship: everyone in it is worn away to skin and bone, and only he still looks like a fat man.
strings.黄德贵没能回到汕头。他姐姐家的饭桌上，后来总多摆一副碗筷，一摆就是好几年，谁也没: Derek Huang never made it back to Shantou. Afterward there was always one extra bowl and one extra pair of chopsticks laid on his sister's table, and laid there for years on end, and no one ever said out loud who they were for.
strings.黄德贵活着回到了汕头，阿杰没有。他在姐姐家门口站了一下午，最后是姐姐自己开的门。: Derek Huang came home to Shantou alive. Jake did not. He stood at his sister's door all afternoon; in the end she opened it herself. She didn't curse him. She asked one thing: "Before he went, did he get water?" Old Huang said he did. Whether that was true, only he knows.
strings.黎明和黄昏时观测太阳和星星，估算筏子的位置和漂流方向，再收放海锚，让筏子尽量顺着: Shoot the sun and the stars at dawn and dusk to work out where the raft is and which way it is drifting, then haul in or pay out the sea anchor so the raft rides the current that will carry it toward the shipping lane. It takes a sense of direction; read it wrong and you drift even farther off.
strings.黑暗里，有人看见了这一幕，没有作声。: In the dark, someone saw it happen and said nothing.
strings.（他从贴身的口袋里掏出一张泡烂了的照片，看了很久，又小心地塞了回去。）: (He took a waterlogged photo from the pocket against his chest, looked at it a long time, then carefully tucked it back.)
strings.（他往筏子里递了一把鱼干，自己先嚼了一条给大家看。）Masarap！好吃！: (He handed a handful of dried fish into the raft and chewed one himself first, to show them.) Masarap! Good!
strings.（他把钓线缠在食指上，闭着眼睛等了半天，忽然一抖手腕——一条鲹鱼被甩上了筏子。）: (He wound the fishing line around his index finger and waited with his eyes shut for the longest time, then flicked his wrist — a trevally came flying up onto the raft.)
strings.（他比了比自己的腰：“我孙子，这么高。”）: (He measured a height against his own waist: "My grandson. This tall.")
strings.（剖鱼的时候，它眼巴巴地蹲在旁边，口水一滴一滴落在浮胎上。）: (While the fish was being gutted, the dog crouched nearby, watching every move, drool falling onto the buoyancy tube drop by drop.)
strings.（半夜，它突然竖起耳朵站起来，朝着北边一动不动，站了很久，又趴下了。）: (In the middle of the night the dog pricked up his ears and stood, facing north, dead still, for a long time. Then he lay down again.)
strings.（它去舔篷布上的露水，舔一会儿，回头看看人。）: (The dog licked the dew off the canopy, licked for a while, then turned its head to look at the people.)
strings.（它把下巴搁在一个人的膝盖上，张着嘴喘，舌头干得发白。）: (The dog rested its chin on someone's knee and panted, mouth open, tongue dry and pale.)
strings.（旺财趴在出入口，耳朵一抖一抖的，冲着黑漆漆的海面低低地呜了一声。）: (Lucky lay at the entrance, ears twitching, and gave a low whimper at the black water.)
strings.（老潘把伤腿往浮胎上挪了挪，哼了一声，没说话。）: (Old Pan shifted his bad leg onto the buoyancy tube, grunted, and said nothing.)
